title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
english: The US Department of Justice has charged three individuals linked to Iran for coordinating a series of terrorist plots across Europe and the US. These suspects are accused of directing various attacks, including a security incident at the RAF Fairford air base in the UK and a stabbing in London. While Iran has denied these claims, US officials state that the group operated under a fake name to carry out nearly 20 violent acts on behalf of Iranian-backed organizations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በአውሮፓ እና በአሜሪካ የሽብር ጥቃቶችን ለማቀነባበር በኢራን የተደገፉ ሶስት ግለሰቦች ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። ተከሳሾቹ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በሚገኘው የRAF Fairford አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ከተፈጸመው ጥርጣሬ እና በለንደን ከተፈጸመው ቢላዋ ጥቃት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ተብሎ ይከሰሳሉ። ኢራን የክሱን ይዘት በጽኑ ብትቃወምም፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ቡድኑ ከ20 በላይ የሚሆኑ የሽብር ተግባራትን በውሸት ስም በመጠቀም ኢራንን በመወከል ለማከናወን መሞከራቸውን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa qaama haqaa sadtatu garee Iranin deeggaraman irratti erga himannaa banee booda, gareen kun Awurooppaa fi Ameerikaa keessatti shororkeessummaa geggeessaa akka turan beekameera. Himatamtoonni kun buufata xiyyaaraa RAF Fairford kan UK keessatti argamu irratti rakkoo uumuufi magaala London keessatti namoota waraananii miidhuu keessatti harka qabu jedhamee shakkamu. Iran himannaa kana kan haaltu ta'us, qondaalonni Ameerikaa gareen kun maqaa sobaa fayyadamuun gocha shororkeessummaa kudhanneen baay'atu raawwachuuf karoorfachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
english: A 41-year-old senior US Army soldier stationed at Imjin Barracks in England has been arrested by British counter-terrorism police on suspicion of spying for Russia. The soldier is accused of illegally obtaining protected information and assisting a foreign intelligence service under the National Security Act. He is currently being held in London while authorities conduct further searches and investigate the serious breach of security.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ በሚገኘው ኢምጂን ባራክስ የጦር ሰፈር ሲያገለግል የነበረ የ41 ዓመት የአሜሪካ ጦር አባል ለሩሲያ ስለላ አድርጓል በሚል በብሪታንያ የፀረ-ሽብር ፖሊስ ተይዟል። ወታደሩ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን በመስረቅ እና ለውጭ ሀገር የስለላ ተቋም ድጋፍ በማድረግ በአገሪቱ ብሔራዊ ደህንነት ህግ ስር ተጠርጥሯል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ግለሰቡ በለንደን እስር ቤት የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ተጨማሪ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Ameerikaa waggaa 41 ta'e kan Ingilizitti buufata waraana Imjin Barracks keessa ture, biyya Rashiyaaf hiddudha (spying) gochuun shakkamee poolisii farra shororkeessitoota Biritishin qabame. Namichi kun odeeffannoo dhoksaa ta'e seeraan ala argachuu fi tajaajila iccitii biyya alaa gargaaruun seera nageenya biyyaa cabsuun shakkama. Ammaaf londan keessatti hidhamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, aangotni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo bal'aa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: US House blocks bid to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, for now
english: The US House of Representatives has blocked an attempt by Republican congressman Thomas Massie to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The motion to remove Hegseth over accusations of unauthorized military action in Iran was sent to a committee, effectively halting the effort before the current congressional session ends. President Trump praised the vote, while Hegseth dismissed the impeachment attempt as a political stunt.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በክስ ለማስወገድ የቀረበውን ጥረት አግዶታል። የሪፐብሊካኑ ኮንግረስ አባል ቶማስ ማሲ ሚኒስትሩ ያለ ኮንግረስ ፈቃድ ኢራን ላይ ጦርነት ከፍተዋል በሚል ያቀረቡት ክስ ወደ ኮሚቴ እንዲዛወር በመደረጉ ጉዳዩ ውድቅ ሆኗል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የድምጽ አሰጣጡን ውጤት በደስታ የተቀበሉ ሲሆን፣ ሄግሴትም የቀረበበት ክስ የፖለቲካ ትርኢት እንጂ ሌላ አይደለም ሲሉ አጣጥለውታል።
oromo: Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummata Amerikaa keessatti, Ministirri Ittisaa Pete Hegseth irratti himata aangoo irraa kaasuu dhihaate hoggantoonni mana marichaa dhaabsisaniiru. Miseensi Kongiresii Rippabilikaanii Thomas Massie, ministirichi hayyama malee Iran irratti waraana baneera jechuun himata kana dhiheessee ture, garuu yaanni kun gara komitiitti ergamee akka gadi dhaabatu ta'eera. Pireezidaant Traamp murtoo kanaan gammachuu isaanii ibsan; Hegseth gamasaaniin himatichi akka waan siyaasaa qofaatti fudhatama akka hin qabne dubbataniiru.

title: 'It can kill us': Kenyans fear impact of El Niño with floods predicted
english: Residents of Kenya's informal settlements, particularly in Kibera, are bracing for severe flooding due to the expected El Niño weather phenomenon. Having suffered tragic losses and destruction during previous rains, many people fear their fragile homes will not withstand the upcoming extreme weather. In response, authorities are cleaning riverbeds and unclogging drainage systems across Nairobi to mitigate the risk of another disaster.
amharic: በኬንያ በተለይም በኪቤራ የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ኤል নিনዮ የተሰኘው የአየር ንብረት ክስተት ሊያስከትል በሚችለው ከፍተኛ ጎርፍ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው። ከዚህ ቀደም በተከሰቱ የዝናብ አደጋዎች ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ያጡና ንብረታቸው የወደመባቸው ሰዎች፣ አሁን የሚጠበቀው ዝናብ ደካማ ቤቶቻቸውን ሊያፈርስ እንደሚችል ይፈራሉ። መንግስትም አደጋውን ለመቀነስ በናይሮቢ የሚገኙ የውሃ ማስተላለፊያ ቦዮችንና የወንዝ ዳርቻዎችን የማጽዳት ስራዎችን እያከናወነ ይገኛል።
oromo: jiraattonni naannolee baadiyyaa fi magaalaa Keeniyaa, keessattuu Kiberaa, sababa jijjiirama qilleensaa El Niinootiin roobni cimaan dhufuu danda'uuf sodaachaa jiru. Balaa roobaa darbe keessatti lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbee fi manni jireenyaa waan miidhameef, namoonni baay'een manni isaanii laafaa ta'ee fi rooba kana dandamachuu akka hin dandeenye yaaddoo qabu. Kanaan walqabatee, mootummaan balaa uumamu xiqqeessuuf, Naayiroobii keessatti bakkeewwan bishaan itti gadi yaa'u fi qarqara laggeenii qulqulleessuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira.

title: Protesters throw milk at Joe Biden during Hunter event in Dublin
english: During a surprise visit to Trinity College in Dublin, former President Joe Biden was targeted by pro-Palestinian protesters who threw milk at him. The demonstration occurred while he was attending an event to see his son, Hunter, receive an award for public discourse. The protesters aimed to express their opposition to the former president’s support for Israel.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ጆ ባይደን በደብሊን በሚገኘው ትሪኒቲ ኮሌጅ ባደረጉት ድንገተኛ ጉብኝት ወቅት በፕሮ-ፍልስጤም ተቃዋሚዎች የወተት ጥቃት ተሰንዝሮባቸዋል። ይህ የተቃውሞ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው ልጃቸው ሀንተር የህዝብ ተሳትፎ ሽልማት በሚቀበልበት ስነስርዓት ላይ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ድርጊቱን የፈጸሙት ለኢስራኤል ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመቃወም ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin duraanii Joo Baayiden magaala Dabliinitti kutaalee kolleejjii Tiriinitii daawwataa jiranitti, hiriirtonni sagantaa Falastiinii deggaran aannaniin isa irratti darbataniiru. Hiriirri kun kan raawwatame yeroo inni ilma isaa Hantar badhaasa fudhachaa jiru arguu dhaqetti. Hiriirtonni kun kanneen aannanii darbatan kun, inni Israa'el gargaaruu isaa mormuuf akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Former Iraqi lawmaker Ahmed al-Alwani found dead in Beirut
english: Former Iraqi parliamentarian Ahmed al-Alwani was discovered dead in a Beirut apartment, leading Lebanese authorities to open a murder investigation. Officials believe he was strangled, and one Lebanese suspect has already been taken into custody while the search for two additional individuals continues. Al-Alwani was a prominent Sunni politician known for opposing the Iraqi government and Iranian influence in the region.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኢራቅ ፓርላማ አባል አህመድ አል-አልዋኒ በቤይሩት በሚገኝ አፓርታማ ውስጥ ሞተው ተገኝተዋል፤ የሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናትም ክስተቱን የነፍስ ማጥፋት ወንጀል በማለት ምርመራ ጀምረዋል። ተጎጂው ታንቀው እንደተገደሉ የመጀመሪያ መረጃዎች የሚያመለክቱ ሲሆን፣ አንድ የሊባኖስ ዜጋ በወንጀሉ ተጠርጥሮ በቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። አል-አልዋኒ በኢራቅ የነበሩ የፖለቲካ ተቃዋሚ እና የኢራንን ተጽእኖ በግልጽ በመቃወም ይታወቁ የነበሩ ሰው ናቸው።
oromo: Miseensi duraanii mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Iraaq kan ta'an Ahmed al-Alwani, magaalaa Beyruutitti mana jireenyaa tokko keessatti du'anii argamuu isaanii hordofee, mootummaan Libaanoos qorannoo ajjeechaa jalqabeera. Qorannoon jalqabaa akka agarsiisutti, namichi kun ukkaamfamanii ajjeefamuun isaanii mirkanaa'ee, namni tokko to'annoo jala ooleera, poolisiin ammoo shakkamtoota biroo lama barbaadaa jira. Al-Alwani siyaasaa biyya Iraaq keessatti gahee guddaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa Iiraan biyyattii keessatti qabdu mormuudhaan beekamu.

title: US charges 3 ‘Iranian-backed’ men over alleged plot at UK Fairford air base
english: The United States has charged three individuals linked to Iranian-backed groups for allegedly plotting terrorist activities, including a scheme to target the RAF Fairford air base in the UK. Prosecutors claim the suspects were acting on behalf of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and Kataib Hezbollah to coordinate attacks across the US and Europe. While one suspect is currently detained in New York, the whereabouts of the other two remain unknown.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ መምሪያ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው የተባሉ ሶስት ግለሰቦች ላይ ሽብርተኝነትን በመሰረተ ክስ መስርቷል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ በእንግሊዝ በሚገኘው የፌርፎርድ አየር ማረፊያ እና በሌሎች የአሜሪካና የአውሮፓ አካባቢዎች የሽብር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም አቅደዋል ተብሎ ተከሷል። አንደኛው ተጠርጣሪ በኒውዮርክ እስር ቤት ውስጥ የሚገኝ ሲሆን የሌሎቹ ሁለቱ ግለሰቦች መገኛ እስካሁን አልታወቀም።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa namoota garee Iran deggaran sadii ta'an irratti qophii shoroorkeessummaa geggeessuu isaanii himatee himata baneera. Namoonni kunneen buufata xiyyaraa RAF Fairford kan UK fi naannawwa biroo Ameerikaa fi Awurooppaa keessatti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfataniiru jedhamee shakkamu. Shakkamtoonni kunneen garee IRGC fi Kataib Hezbollah waliin hariiroo akka qaban himameera; shakkamaan tokko New York keessatti yeroo hidhamee jiru, kanneen biroo lama garuu bakki jiran hin beekamu.

title: Republicans block Hegseth impeachment motion
english: Republican lawmakers in the United States have successfully halted a move to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth. The impeachment attempt was linked to controversies involving military actions against Iran, operations concerning Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro, and naval attacks on vessels in the Caribbean. Consequently, the motion will not proceed at this time.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ አባላት የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሰትን ለመክሰስ የቀረበውን ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ ክስ ከኢራን ጋር በተያያዙ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች፣ ከቬንዙዌላው መሪ ኒኮላስ ማዱሮ ጋር በተገናኘ ጉዳዮች እንዲሁም በካሪቢያን ባህር ውስጥ በተፈጸሙ የባህር ኃይል ጥቃቶች ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። በዚህም ምክንያት የመክሰስ ሂደቱ እንዲቋረጥ ተደርጓል።
oromo: Miseensoni paartii Rippaabilikaanii kan Ameerikaa, ministeera ittisaa Piit Heegseetiin aangoo irraa kaasuuf dhihaate mormuun dhaabsisaniiru. Yaaliin aangoo irraa kaasuun kun waraana Iiraan, dhimma hogganaa Veenezuweelaa Niikolaas Maaduuroo fi haleellaa markaba naannoo Kaaribiyaanitti raawwatamee wajjin wal qabata. Kanaafuu, dhimmi kun gara fuulduraatti akka hin adeemne murtaa'eera.

title: Tigray displaced families fear renewed war as hopes of returning home fade
english: Families displaced by the Tigray war continue to live in temporary shelters, such as schools, years after fleeing their homes. Although a peace agreement was signed in 2022, unresolved territorial disputes and a recent escalation in fighting have dashed their hopes of returning. Many remain stuck in uncertain conditions as renewed violence threatens the stability of the region.
amharic: በትግራይ ጦርነት ምክንያት የተፈናቀሉ ቤተሰቦች ከቤታቸው ከወጡ ዓመታት ያለፉ ቢሆንም አሁንም በትምህርት ቤቶች እና በጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች ውስጥ መኖርን ይገደዳሉ። እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተፈረመው የሰላም ስምምነት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ የወሰን ግጭቶች እና በቅርቡ የተቀሰቀሰው አዲስ ውጊያ ወደ ቀያቸው የመመለስ ተስፋቸውን አጨልሞታል። አሁን ባለው የጸጥታ ችግር ምክንያት በርካቶች በከፍተኛ እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Maatiin waraana Tigraayiin buqqa’an waggoota hedduu boodas mana barumsaa fi bakkeewwan yeroodhaaf qophaa’an keessa jiraachuu itti fufaniiru. Walii galteen nagaa bara 2022 mallatteeffame iyyuu, dhimmi daangaa fi walitti bu’iinsi dhiyeenya kana dhalate abdii gara manaatti deebi’uu isaanii fageesseera. Waraanni haarome kun nagaa naannichaa waan miidheef, maatiin kunneen haala dhugaatti rakkaachaa fi abdii kutatanii jiru.

title: Analysis: The changing face of Israel’s ultra-Orthodox politics
english: The ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism party has signaled a potential shift in Israeli politics by withholding its recommendation for Benjamin Netanyahu to lead the new government. This move highlights internal instability, including challenges to veteran leadership and evolving views among the younger Haredi generation. Recent regional tensions have influenced these communities, suggesting that traditional religious political alliances are no longer guaranteed.
amharic: የእስራኤል እጅግ ኦርቶዶክሳዊ የሆነው የተባበሩት የቶራህ ይሁዲነት ፓርቲ ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ አለመደገፉ በእስራኤል ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ መኖሩን ያሳያል። ይህ ውሳኔ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ያለውን የአመራር ክፍፍል እና የወጣቱ ትውልድ አስተሳሰብ መቀየርን ያንጸባርቃል። በክልሉ የተፈጠሩት ወቅታዊ ሁኔታዎች ባህላዊ የፖለቲካ አጋርነቶችን እየፈተኑ መሆኑን ይህ ክስተት ያሳያል።
oromo: Paartiin ultra-Orthodox kan Yunaaytid Tooraah Yudaayizim jedhamu, Binyamiin Netaanyaahuun mootummaa haaraa akka hundeessan deggeruu dhiisuun isaa jijjiirama siyaasaa Israa'el keessatti mul'achaa jiru argisiisa. Tarkaanfiin kun qeeqa dura buutota paartichaa irratti ka'aa jiru fi jijjiirama yaadaa dhaloota dargaggeessaa keessatti mul'atu agarsiisa. Haalli yeroo ammaa naannichatti uumame, walitti dhufeenyi siyaasaa aadaa ta'e durii ture jijjiirama keessa akka jiru mirkaneessa.

title: US Treasury chief moved to military base after alleged Iranian threats: Report
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was relocated to a military base due to credible threats against him linked to Iran. Intelligence reports indicate that Iranian efforts to target American officials have become more aggressive and are now in advanced phases. The Trump administration is taking these security warnings seriously as they monitor rising threats against US personnel.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት ከኢራን የመጡ ስጋቶች በመኖራቸው ወደ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ እንዲዛወሩ ተደርገዋል። የኢንተለጀንስ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ኢራን በአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ላይ የምታደርገው ጥቃት እየተጠናከረ እና ወደ ወሳኝ ምዕራፍ መሸጋገሩን ነው። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በአሜሪካኖች ላይ የተጋረጠውን ይህንን የጸጥታ ስጋት በቁም ነገር በመመልከት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ministeerri Bajataa Ameerikaa Iskootti Besent, sodaalee gara Iran irraa dhufaniin walqabatee gara buufata waraanaatti akka jijjiiraman taasifamaniiru. Odeeffannooleen icciitii akka agarsiisanitti, Iran hojjettoota mootummaa Ameerikaa irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf yaalii gootu daran dabaluun ishee fi karoorri ishees sadarkaa ol'aana irra gahuun ibsameera. Bulchiinsi Traamp, sodaalee haaraa ba'aa jiran kana irraa ka'uun eegumsa cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: ‘All I can do is hug my children and cry’: Palestinians in Gaza face deadly winter floods
english: Heavy winter rains have caused severe flooding in Gaza, creating dire living conditions for families forced to reside in flimsy tents and damaged buildings. This situation is further aggravated by ongoing restrictions on humanitarian aid, which block the delivery of essential supplies like blankets and repair materials. Many displaced people are struggling to cope as they deal with the dual trauma of extreme weather and limited access to basic survival needs.
amharic: በጋዛ እየዘነበ ያለው ከባድ የክረምት ዝናብና የጎርፍ አደጋ በድንኳንና በተጎዱ ቤቶች ውስጥ ለሚኖሩ ተፈናቃዮች ከፍተኛ ችግር ፈጥሯል። እስራኤል ለሰብአዊ እርዳታ የጣለችው ገደብ ብርድ ልብሶችንና ሌሎች መጠለያዎችን ለመጠገን የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶች እንዳይገቡ በማድረጓ ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አባብሶታል። በችግር ውስጥ ያሉ ቤተሰቦችም በከባድ የአየር ንብረትና በመሠረታዊ የኑሮ ፍላጎቶች እጥረት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስቃይ እየደረሰባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Roobni cimaa fi lolaan Gaazaatti mudate, maatiiwwan dunkaana fi manneen miidhaman keessa jiraatan irratti rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Hanga ammaa hangafoota gargaarsa namoomaa irratti jirun, meeshaalee akka uffata ho'aa fi bu'uuraalee suphaa akka hin galle dhorkuun isaa rakkinicha hammaachiseera. Namoonni buqqa'an kunneen haala qilleensa hamaa fi dhabama meeshaalee bu'uuraa waliin wal'aansoo godhaa jiru.

title: US Republicans derail bid to impeach Pentagon chief
english: US House Republicans have stopped an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth by sending the resolution to a committee instead of a floor vote. This move effectively blocks the effort to remove the Pentagon chief following criticisms regarding the war in Iran. The decision provides a significant political win for President Donald Trump shortly after his party's recent electoral challenges.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ሪፐብሊካኖች የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት የመክሰስ ሙከራን አግደዋል። የክስ መዝገቡን ለምክር ቤቱ የፍትህ ኮሚቴ በመምራት ጉዳዩ በጉባኤ ላይ እንዳይወሰን አድርገዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ላይ ሊደርስ የነበረውን ጫና በማስወገድ ለፕሬዝዳንቱ የፖለቲካ ድል አስገኝቷል።
oromo: Miseensonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii kan mana maree bakka bu'oota ummataa Ameerikaa, ministira ittisaa Pite Hegeeseet irratti dhiyaate ture itti gaafatamummaa irraa kaasuuf yaalame dhaabsisaniiru. Himannaan kun sagalee mana mareetiin osoo hin ilaalamin gara komitee seeraatti akka darbu godhameera. Tarkaanfiin kun prezidaant Doonaald Tiraampiif injifannoo siyaasaa ta'ee jira.

title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
english: Thomas Markle, the father of the Duchess of Sussex, has been returned to federal custody in Florida after authorities accused him of removing his court-ordered ankle monitor. He was recently arrested on charges related to the possession of child sexual abuse material found in storage units. A judge denied his bond and ordered a medical evaluation, citing that his current living arrangements are unsuitable for house detention.
amharic: የዱቼስ ኦፍ ሱሴክስ አባት የሆኑት ቶማስ ማርክል በፍርድ ቤት የታዘዘባቸውን የክትትል መሳሪያ (አንክል ሞኒተር) በማውለቃቸው እንደገና በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ባለፈው ሳምንት በህጻናት ላይ የሚፈጸም የወሲብ ጥቃት ምስሎችን ይዘዋል በሚል ክስ ተይዘው በቤት ውስጥ እስር እንዲቆዩ ተወስኖባቸው ነበር። አሁን ግን ዳኛው የዋስ መብታቸውን በመከልከልና የጤና ምርመራ እንዲያደርጉ በማዘዝ ወደ እስር ቤት ተመልሰዋል።
oromo: Abbaan Duchess of Sussex, Thomas Markle, meeshaa isaaniin hordofuuf hidhamee ture ofirraa baasuun isaanii erga himatamee booda gara mana hidhaatti deebifamaniiru. Isaanis torban darbe qabeenya suuraa gudeeddii daa'immanii of keessaa qabu jedhamee shakkamee qabamuun isaanii ni yaadatama. Abbaan seeraa tokko mirga wabii isaanii dhowwatee, akkasumas haalli jireenya isaanii mijataa waan hin taaneef qorannoon fayyaa akka godhamuuf ajajaniiru.

title: Malaysia's disgraced former PM leaves jail for house arrest after embezzling millions
english: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak has been moved from prison to serve the remainder of his corruption sentence under house arrest at his private residence. He was previously convicted for his central role in the massive 1MDB financial scandal, which involved the theft of billions from a state fund. While a royal pardon allowed for this transition, the decision has drawn criticism from those concerned about the integrity of Malaysia's anti-corruption efforts.
amharic: የማሌዢያ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናጂብ ራዛክ በሙስና ወንጀል የተፈረደባቸውን የእስር ጊዜ ቀሪ ክፍል በቤታቸው እንዲያሳልፉ ከእስር ቤት ወደ መኖሪያ ቤታቸው ተዛውረዋል። የቀድሞው መሪ በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር የአገሪቱን ገንዘብ በማጭበርበር በተከሰሱበት ታዋቂው የ1MDB ቅሌት ጥፋተኛ ተብለው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ንጉሣዊ ይቅርታ አግኝተው ወደ ቤታቸው ቢመለሱም፣ ይህ ውሳኔ የሙስና መከላከል ጥረትን እንደሚጎዳ በመግለጽ በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa duraanii Maaleeshiyaa Naajiib Raazaak, yakka malaammaltummaa irratti itti murtaa'eef mana hidhaa turan sana xumura isaa mana isaanii keessatti akka dabarsan ajajamee gara manaatti deebi'aniiru. Inni kanaan dura maallaqa biyyattii biliyoonaan lakkaawwamu saamuu isaa irratti shakkamee yakka '1MDB' jedhamuun qabamee ture. Mootichi dhiifama gochuun isaa gara manaatti akka deebi'an hayyamus, murteen kun duula malaammaltummaa balleessuuf godhamu irratti dhiibbaa akka qabu hoggantoonni fi sabaan mormameera.

title: Violence erupts in Bangladesh as ousted PM's supporters stage protest
english: Supporters of Bangladesh's former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina recently held nationwide protests demanding her return from exile in India, leading to violent clashes with security forces. Demonstrators set fire to vehicles and blocked roads, resulting in at least one death and significant travel disruptions. This marks the first major organized demonstration by Hasina's party members since her removal from power in 2024 following widespread public unrest.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና ደጋፊዎች እርሳቸው ከህንድ በስደት እንዲመለሱ በመጠየቅ በአገሪቱ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። በጸጥታ ሃይሎች እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭትም የተሽከርካሪዎች መቃጠልን ጨምሮ ብጥብጥ ተቀስቅሷል፣ ይህም የአንድ ሰው ህይወት እንዲያልፍ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ይህ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ የፓርቲያቸው ደጋፊዎች ያደረጉት የመጀመሪያው ትልቅ የተደራጀ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ነው።
oromo: Deeggartonni ministira muummee durii kan Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina, isaan biyya Hindi irraa gara biyyaatti akka deebi'an gaafachuun magaalonni garaagaraa keessatti hiriira mormii godhaniiru. Hiriirichi gara walitti bu'insa humnoota nageenyaa wajjin godhametti jijjiiramuun, konkolaatonni gubachuu fi namni tokko lubbuun isaa darbuun gabaafameera. Hiriirri kun erga Sheikh Hasina bara 2024 aangoo irraa bu'anii booda, deeggartoota isaaniitiin qindaa'ee kan godhame hiriira gurguddaa jalqabaa ti.

title: Spain's king and queen attend memorial service for rail crash victims
english: King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia of Spain joined grieving families and government officials for a funeral mass honoring the 69 people killed in a recent high-speed train collision near Urda. The accident, which remains under investigation, is the country’s deadliest rail disaster in over a decade and has sparked calls for improved safety standards. During the ceremony, the royal couple offered their condolences to the families of the victims while the nation grapples with the political fallout and ongoing rail safety concerns.
amharic: የስፔኑ ንጉሥ ፊሊፔ ስድስተኛ እና ንግሥት ሌቲዚያ በኡርዳ አቅራቢያ በደረሰው የባቡር አደጋ ሕይወታቸውን ላጡ 69 ሰዎች በተዘጋጀው የጸሎት ሥነ-ሥርዓት ላይ ተገኝተዋል። ከ10 ዓመታት በላይ በስፔን ታሪክ የከፋው ይህ አደጋ በባቡር መስመሩ ደህንነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን የምርመራ ሂደቱም ቀጥሏል። የንጉሣዊው ቤተሰብ አባላት ለሟቾች ቤተሰቦች መጽናናትን የተመኙ ሲሆን አገሪቱም በባቡር ትራንስፖርት ደህንነት ጉዳይ ላይ ከፍተኛ ክርክር ውስጥ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Mootichi Ispeen Filiipee VI fi Mootittiin Letiziyaa namoota 69 balaa baaburaa magaala Urdaa biratti dhiheenya kana mudateen lubbuun isaanii darbeef yaadannoo gaggeeffame irratti argamaniiru. Balaan kun waggoota kudhan darbaniif biyyattii keessatti balaa baaburaa cimaa waan ta'eef, dhimmi kun sakatta'iinsa keessa jiraachuun isaa ibsameera. Miseensonni maatii mootummaa maatii miidhamtootaa jajjabeessuun kan dura bu'an yoo ta'u, biyyattis akkaataa nageenya daandii baaburaa fooyyessuun danda'amu irratti marii cimaa keessa jirti.

title: Massive fire as Israeli settlers burn down business near Nablus
english: Israeli settlers recently set fire to a mechanic workshop and a vehicle scrapyard in the Palestinian village of Luban ash-Sharqiya, located near Nablus. Local residents captured footage of the incident as firefighters struggled to extinguish the large blaze. This act of violence has caused significant destruction to the local Palestinian-owned business.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሉባን አሽ-ሻርቂያ መንደር የፍልስጤም ንብረት የሆነ የሜካኒክ አውደ ጥናት እና የመኪና መጋዘን በእሳት አቃጠሉ። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ሲታገሉ በነበሩ የእሳት አደጋ ሠራተኞች ላይ የተቀረጸውን ምስል በቪዲዮ መዝግበዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በባለቤቶቹ ንብረት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Buqqaattoonni Israa'el ganda Lubaan ash-Shaargiyaa kan Naablusitti dhihoo jiru keessatti bakka suphaa konkolaataa fi iddoo kosii konkolaataa kan namoota Falasxiin ta'e ibiddan gubaniiru. Jiraattonni naannichaa yeroo dhaamsiibdonni ibiddaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii gochaa turan viidiyoodhaan qabataniiru. Gochi kun qabeenya namoota Falasxiin irra miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: French far-right author Zemmour launches second presidential bid
english: Far-right author and political figure Eric Zemmour has officially announced his candidacy for the 2027 French presidential election. He is campaigning on a strict platform that aims to significantly reduce immigration and deport foreign residents who are unemployed or convicted of crimes. Zemmour enters the race as a competitor to Marine Le Pen, who is currently considered the favorite to succeed President Emmanuel Macron.
amharic: የቀኝ ዘመም አቀንቃኙ እና ደራሲው ኤሪክ ዘሙር ለፈረንሳይ የ2027 የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ በይፋ እጩ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እሳቸው ስደተኞችን ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ደረጃ ለመቀነስ እና ስራ አጥ የሆኑ ወይም በወንጀል የተከሰሱ የውጭ ዜጎችን ከፈረንሳይ ለማባረር ያለመ ጥብቅ መርሃ ግብር ይዘው እየቀረቡ ነው። ዘሙር በምርጫው ከሚወዳደሩት እና በአሁኑ ወቅት የፕሬዚዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮንን ቦታ ይይዛሉ ተብሎ ከሚጠበቁት ማሪን ለፔን ጋር ይፎካከራሉ።
oromo: Barreessaan fi nama siyaasaa mirga-qaxxaamuraa (far-right) kan ta'an Eerik Zeemuur, filannoo pirezidaantummaa Faransaayi kan bara 2027 irratti akka hirmaatan beeksisaniiru. Inni sagantaa baqattoota hir'isuu fi lammiilee biyya alaa hojii dhabanii ykn yakkaan himataman biyyatti ari'uun irratti xiyyeeffatu baasee socho'aa jira. Zeemuur filannoo kana irratti kan dorgomu kanneen akka Maariin Le Peen, kanneen pirezidaant Eemaanu'eel Maakroon bakka bu'uuf carraa guddaa qaban jedhamanii yaadamu waliini.

title: Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move
english: Russia has expelled a Moldovan diplomat in a retaliatory move following Moldova's decision to remove a Russian embassy official. This friction stems from Moldova's claim that a Russian drone carrying explosives crashed on its territory, a charge the Kremlin has denied. Tensions between the two nations continue to rise as Moldova actively seeks to reduce its dependency on Russian energy by integrating its power grid with Europe.
amharic: ሞልዶቫ የሩሲያ ኤምባሲ ሰራተኛን ካባረረች በኋላ፣ ሩሲያ በበቀል እርምጃ አንድ የሞልዶቫ ዲፕሎማትን ከሀገር አስወጥታለች። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው የሞልዶቫ ባለስልጣናት ፈንጂ የያዘ የሩሲያ ድሮን በግዛታቸው ላይ መውደቁን በመግለጻቸው ሲሆን፣ ክሬምሊን ግን ይህንን ክስ አስተባብሏል። ሞልዶቫ የኃይል አቅርቦቷን ከአውሮፓ ጋር በማስተሳሰር ከሩሲያ ያለባትን ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ በምትጥርበት በዚህ ወቅት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት እያሽቆለቆለ መጥቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Raashiyaa, biyyi Moldoovaa qondaala embaasii Raashiyaa biyyatti ishee baasuu hordofee, gama isaatiin diplomata Moldoovaa tokko biyyattii baaseera. Wal-dhabdeen kun kan uumame, erga mootummaan Moldoovaa xiyyaaraan nama hin qabne kan meeshaa waraanaa baatu tokko biyyatti isaanii irratti kufuusaa ibsee booda. Mootummaan Moldoovaa fedhii isaa kan ta'e humna ibsaa Raashiyaa irraa bilisa ba'uuf adeemsa guddinaa irra kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii caalaatti hammaachisee jira.

title: US House Republicans reject effort to impeach Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth
english: US House Republicans have blocked an attempt to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, effectively ending efforts to remove him from office. Representative Thomas Massie led the impeachment push, citing concerns over the secretary's role in the Iran war and military strikes conducted without congressional approval. The Republican party majority successfully sidelined the resolution, preventing a formal vote on the charges and shielding the Pentagon chief from immediate repercussions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ሪፐብሊካኖች የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በክስ ከስልጣን የማውረድ ጥረትን አግደዋል። የሪፐብሊካን ተወካይ ቶማስ ማሲ ሚኒስትሩ ያለ ህግ አውጪው ፈቃድ ከኢራን ጋር ጦርነት ከፍተዋል በሚል ክሱን መርተውት ነበር። የሪፐብሊካን አባላት በአብላጫ ድምፅ ጉዳዩን ወደ ኮሚቴ በመምራት ውድቅ አድርገውታል፣ ይህም ሄግሴት ከስልጣን እንዳይወገዱ አድርጓል።
oromo: Miseensonni mana maree bakka bu'oota ummataa Ameerikaa (US) kan Ripablikaanotaa, ministeera ittisaa Piit Hegseth aangoo irraa kaasuuf dhihaate ture fashaleessaniiru. Bakka bu'aan Thomas Massie ministeerichi hayyama mana maree malee waraana Iraan waliin geggeesseera jechuun himannaa kana dhiheessanii turan. Haa ta'u malee, miseensonni Ripablikaanotaa hedduun himannicha komitee keessatti qabsiisuun akka hin fudhatamne godhaniiru.

title: UNIFIL patrol comes under fire in southern Lebanon
english: A UN peacekeeping patrol was targeted by gunfire near Wadi Jilu in southern Lebanon, though no injuries were reported. The peacekeepers returned fire and are currently calling for a formal investigation into the incident. This attack highlights ongoing regional instability as the mission's mandate is set to expire at the end of 2026.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በዋዲ ጂሉ አካባቢ የሚንቀሳቀስ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ጦር ጥቃት ደርሶበታል፤ በዕለቱም ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት አልጠፋም። የሰላም አስከባሪዎቹ የተኮሱትን በመመለስ ሁኔታውን ያረጋጉ ሲሆን፣ በድርጊቱ ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግም ጠይቀዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በክልሉ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ተልዕኮም በ2026 መጨረሻ ላይ ሊያበቃ ቀጠሮ ተይዞለታል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenya kabachiistoota tokkummaa mootummootaa kibba Libanon, naannoo Waadii Jiiluu keessatti dhukaasa irratti banamee ture; ta'us miidhaan qaamaa tokko illee hin geenye. Humnoonni kunis dhukaasa deebisanii kan banan yoo ta'u, qorannoon hatattamaa akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii dhabuu naannichaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, ergamni nageenya kabachiistota kanaas dhuma bara 2026 akka xumuramuuf karoorfamee jira.

title: US House Democrat leader Jeffries will retain position despite opposition, sources say
english: Hakeem Jeffries is expected to remain the Democratic leader in the U.S. House of Representatives because there are no viable challengers for his role. Although some progressive members and voters are unhappy with his leadership and policy stances, party unity makes it difficult for any opposition to succeed. Consequently, he remains the clear choice to continue guiding the caucus.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የዴሞክራቶች መሪ ሀኪም ጄፍሪስ፣ ተፎካካሪ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት በኃላፊነታቸው እንደሚቀጥሉ ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ የፓርቲው አባላት እና ደጋፊዎች በፖሊሲያቸው ላይ ቅሬታ ቢኖራቸውም፣ በፓርቲው ውስጥ ያለውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት ሌላ አማራጭ መሪ የለም። በዚህም ምክንያት ጄፍሪስ የመሪነቱን ቦታ ይዘው እንደሚቀጥሉ እርግጥ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hakeem Jeffriis hoogganaa paartii Dimokraatawoo kan ta'an, dorgomtoonni hin jiran waan ta'eef bakka isaan jiranitti itti fufuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Miseensonni paartichaa fi deggertoonni tokko tokko ilaalcha siyaasaa isaanarratti mormii qabaatanis, bakka bu'aan isaan bakka bu'u garuu hin jiru. Kanaafuu, Jeffriis hoogganaa paartichaa ta'anii itti fufuun isaanii kan hin oolle dha.

title: Japan pledges $1.97m to support Gaza health response
english: Japan has partnered with the World Health Organization to donate nearly $2 million to assist with healthcare services in Gaza. This funding will primarily be used to set up a specialized coordination center for emergency medical teams in Gaza City. The agreement was finalized in Ramallah by representatives from both Japan and the WHO to strengthen the region's medical response capabilities.
amharic: ጃፓን በጋዛ ያለውን የጤና አገልግሎት ለመደገፍ ከዓለም የጤና ድርጅት ጋር በመተባበር ወደ 2 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጋ የአሜሪካ ዶላር እርዳታ ሰጥታለች። ይህ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በዋናነት በጋዛ ከተማ ለአስቸኳይ ጊዜ የህክምና ቡድኖች የማስተባበሪያ ማዕከል ለማቋቋም ይውላል። ስምምነቱ በሁለቱ አካላት ተወካዮች አማካኝነት በራማላህ የተፈረመ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በክልሉ ያለውን የህክምና አቅም ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Japan tajaajila fayyaa Gaazaa keessatti kennamu deeggaruuf Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa waliin ta'uun doolaara miiliyoona lamaan dhihaatu arjoomteetti. Gargaarsi kun kan oolu beekumsa addaa fi qindoomina garee ogeeyyii yaala ariifachiisaa Gaazaa keessatti dhaabuuf dha. Waliigalteen kun bakka bu'oota gamasii kanaan magaalaa Raamaalaa keessatti kan mallatteeffame yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas dandeettii yaala naannichaa guddifachuu dha.

title: US House Democrat leader Jeffries will retain position despite opposition, sources say
english: Hakeem Jeffries is widely expected to remain the leader of the House Democrats and potentially become the next Speaker of the House, despite significant public opposition. Critics argue that he is too closely aligned with corporate interests and pro-Israel lobbying groups, failing to represent the party's progressive base. However, experts suggest that internal party discipline and the symbolic importance of him becoming the first Black Speaker will likely help him secure the position when the vote occurs next week.
amharic: ሃኪም ጄፍሪስ በህዝብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥመውም፣ በምክር ቤቱ የዴሞክራቶች መሪነቱን እንደሚቀጥል እና ቀጣዩ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አፈ-ጉባኤ እንደሚሆን ይጠበቃል። ተቺዎቹ እርሱ ከድርጅቶች እና ከእስራኤል ደጋፊ ቡድኖች ጋር የጠበቀ ግንኙነት ስላለው የፓርቲውን ተራማጅ አቋም እንደማያንጸባርቅ ይከራከራሉ። ሆኖም የፓርቲው የውስጥ ዲሲፕሊን እና የመጀመሪያው ጥቁር አፈ-ጉባኤ የመሆኑ ታሪካዊ ፋይዳ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ድጋፍ እንዲያገኝ እንደሚረዳው ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Hakeem Jeffries mormii guddaa uummata keessaa jiraatus, hogganaa paartii Dimokiraatotaa ta'ee itti fufuufi kan itti aanu af-yaa'ii Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa ta'uun isaa ni eegama. Komattoonni inni fedhii dhaabbilee gurguddaa fi gareewwan Israa'el deggeran waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qabaachuun isaa, yaada paartichaa gara fuulduraa kan hin bakka buune ta'uu dubbatu. Haata'u malee, qajeelfama keessoo paartichaa fi seenaa isa af-yaa'ii gurraacha jalqabaa ta'uuf jiruun walqabatee, sagalee torbee dhufu kennamuun mo'achuuf carraa guddaa akka qabu ogeeyyoonni ni ibsu.

title: Fire breaks out on platform in Iran’s South Pars field
english: A fire occurred on a platform at Iran's South Pars gas field, though authorities confirm the situation is currently under control. While the cause is still being investigated, officials suspect it may have resulted from a gas leak or a technical error. The affected platform represents a very small fraction of the field's total daily gas production.
amharic: በኢራን ሳውዝ ፓርስ የተፈጥሮ ጋዝ ማውጫ ቦታ ላይ ባለው መድረክ ላይ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል፣ ነገር ግን ባለስልጣናት ሁኔታው አሁን ሙሉ በሙሉ በቁጥጥር ስር መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። የእሳቱ መንስኤ በጋዝ መፍሰስ ወይም በቴክኒክ ችግር የተፈጠረ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ቢጠረጠርም ምርመራው ቀጥሏል። ጉዳት የደረሰበት መድረክ ከጠቅላላው የዕለት ምርት ውስጥ በጣም አነስተኛውን ድርሻ ብቻ የሚይዝ ነው።
oromo: Buufata gaazii 'South Pars' kan Iran keessatti bakka gaazii itti baafamu tokko irratti ibiddi ka’ee ture, ta’us abbootiin taayitaa haallichi ammatti to’annoo jala jiraachuu ibsaniiru. Sababiin ibidichaa qulqulleeffamaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, gaazii yaa’uu ykn dogoggora teeknikaatiin ta’uu mala jedhamee shakkama. Buufatni miidhaan irra ga’e kun oomisha gaazii guyyaatti argamu guutuu keessaa hamma baayyee xiqqoo qofa kan qabatu dha.

title: US charges three 'Iranian operatives' over UK air base plot
english: The United States Department of Justice has officially charged three men identified as Iranian operatives for their involvement in a plot to attack the RAF Fairford air base in the United Kingdom. The accused individuals, named Al-Saadi, Mohajeri, and Al-Hassani, are linked to a security incident that occurred at the site last September. This specific base has been utilized by the U.S. military for operations directed at Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፍትህ መምሪያ በእንግሊዝ በሚገኘው የRAF Fairford አየር ማረፊያ ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር አቅደዋል በተባሉ ሶስት የኢራን ወኪሎች ላይ ክስ መስርቷል። አል-ሳዲ፣ ሞሃጄሪ እና አል-ሀሳኒ የተባሉት ተጠርጣሪዎች ባለፈው መስከረም ወር በዚሁ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ በተፈጠረ የጸጥታ ችግር ውስጥ እጃቸው እንዳለበት ይነገራል። ይህ የአየር ማረፊያ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች በኢራን ላይ በሚያደርጓቸው ስራዎች ሲጠቀሙበት የቆየ ጣቢያ ነው።
oromo: Manni Maree Haqaa Ameerikaa namoota sadan ergamtoota Iraan jedhaman irratti buufata xiyyaraa RAF Fairford kan biyya Ingiliziirratti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfataniiru jechuun himannaa banera. Namoonni himatamanii, Al-Saadi, Mohajeri fi Al-Hassani, ji'a Fulbaana darbe buufata sana keessatti rakkoo nageenyaa uumame waliin wal qabatu. Buufanni kun waraana Ameerikaa kan Iraan irratti duula gaggeessuuf itti fayyadamaa turanidha.

title: Ethiopia’s Intellectual Crisis Begins With a Culture of Conformity
english: The article explores why Ethiopian intellectual life struggles, pointing to a deeply rooted cultural tendency to prioritize conformity over critical thinking. By examining the impact of social conditioning, the author argues that discouraging questioning from childhood creates a system where fear and imitation silence independent voices. Ultimately, the piece suggests that moving forward requires a shift toward valuing innovation and challenging the status quo to ensure the country can learn from its past mistakes.
amharic: ጽሁፉ የኢትዮጵያ ምሁራዊ ህይወት ለምን ለችግር እንደተጋለጠ በመመርመር፣ ለጥያቄዎች ቦታ የማይሰጥና መተግበርን የሚያስቀድም ባህላዊ ተጽዕኖ ዋና ምክንያት እንደሆነ ያብራራል። ከልጅነት ጀምሮ በቤተሰብና በትምህርት ቤት የሚፈጠረው አፈና፣ ሰዎች ነጻ አስተሳሰብን ከመግለጽ እንዲቆጠቡ እንደሚያደርግ ይገልጻል። በመጨረሻም፣ ሀገሪቱ ካለፈችበት ታሪክ እንድትማርና ወደፊት እንድትራመድ፣ የፈጠራ አስተሳሰብን ማበረታታትና የተለመደውን የአመለካከት እስራት መስበር እንደሚያስፈልግ ይጠቁማል።
oromo: Barruun kun jireenyi sammuu fi yaadaa Itoophiyaa maaliif akka guddachuu dadhabe qorata; kunis aadaa gaaffii kaasuuf bakka hin kennine fi namoota hunda hordofanii akka yaadan godhu irraa kan madde akka ta’e ibsa. Ijoollummaadhaa kaasee gaaffii gaafachuu akka hammeenyaatti ilaalun, soda fi amala of qabachuu akka uume dubbata. Dhumarrattis, biyyattiin seenaa ishee irraa barachuu fi gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfachuu akka dandeessuuf, yaada haaraa uumuu fi akkaataa itti yaadamuu keessatti jijjiirama fiduun barbaachisaa ta’uu akeeka.

title: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
english: French authorities have conducted searches at properties linked to the late Mohamed Al Fayed, including the Ritz hotel, as part of an investigation into allegations of sexual abuse and human trafficking. During this collaborative operation with British police, several individuals were detained for questioning and subsequently released. Investigators are now analyzing seized digital evidence to advance the ongoing case involving the former Harrods owner.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት በሟቹ ሞሃመድ አል ፋየድ ላይ የቀረቡትን የጾታዊ ጥቃት እና የሰዎች ዝውውር ክስ ለመመርመር በሪትዝ ሆቴልን ጨምሮ ከእርሳቸው ጋር ግንኙነት ባላቸው ቦታዎች ላይ ብርበራ አካሂደዋል። ከብሪታንያ ፖሊስ ጋር በጋራ በተከናወነው በዚህ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት፣ ለጥያቄ ተይዘው የነበሩ በርካታ ግለሰቦች ቆይተው ተለቀዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ጉዳዩን በጥልቀት ለመመርመር ከተያዙት ዲጂታል መረጃዎች የተገኙ ማስረጃዎችን እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay qorannoo himannaa dararaa saalaa fi gurgurtaa namaa Mohaamad Al Faayid irratti dhihaate hordofee, hoteela Riitz dabalatee qabeenyawwan isaa irratti sakatta'iinsa taasiseera. Qorannoo poolisii Biriitishii waliin ta'uun gaggeeffame kanaan, namoonni muraasni gaaffii fi deebii gaggeessuuf qabamanii booda gadi lakkifamaniiru. Qaamoleen nageenyaa gabaasaa fi ragaalee dijiitaalaa qabaman qorachaa jiru.

title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
english: Israel's newly elected parliament has officially taken office, initiating a high-stakes period for political leaders to assemble a stable governing coalition. Neither the bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot nor the one headed by caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu secured a majority, leaving the country in a state of political uncertainty. While Netanyahu remains in power temporarily, both leaders have exchanged harsh criticisms as they scramble to secure enough support to form a government.
amharic: የእስራኤል አዲስ ፓርላማ በይፋ ስራውን የጀመረ ሲሆን የፖለቲካ መሪዎች የተረጋጋ መንግስት ለመመስረት ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። የጋዲ አይዘንኮት ቡድን እና የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ቡድን አንዳቸውም አብላጫ ድምፅ ማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው አገሪቱ በፖለቲካዊ አለመረጋጋት ውስጥ ትገኛለች። ኔታንያሁ እስከሚቀጥለው መንግስት ድረስ ጊዜያዊ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሆነው የሚቀጥሉ ሲሆን፣ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ስልጣን ለመያዝ እርስ በርስ ጠንካራ ትችቶችን እየተለዋወጡ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Parlamaan Israa'el haaraan guyyaa har'aa hojii eegaleera; hogganoonni siyaasichaa mootummaa tasagga'aa ta'e hundeessuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Gamtaan Gadii Aayizenkootiin durfamuufi kan ministira mummee yeroo ammaa Benjaamin Netiyaahuun durfamu harka caalu waan hin arganneef, biyyattiin yeroo shakkiifi duubatti deebi'iinsa siyaasaa keessa jirti. Netiyaahuun hanga mootummaan haaraan hundaa'utti itti-gaafatamummaa isaanii itti fufu, garuu hogganoonni lamaanuu deggeraa argachuuf jecha wal-coraa jiru.

title: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
english: The Judicial Committee of the Privy Council in London has struck down colonial-era laws that criminalized same-sex intimacy in Trinidad and Tobago. This historic ruling concludes an 11-year legal challenge led by activist Jason Jones, who argued that these laws violated the fundamental right to privacy. The court determined that such prohibitions are incompatible with modern standards of individual freedom, marking a significant step toward equality for the LGBTQ+ community in the region.
amharic: በለንደን የሚገኘው የሕግ ምክር ቤት በትሪኒዳድ እና ቶቤጎ ግብረ-ሰዶማዊነትን የወንጀል ድርጊት የሚያደርጉ ከቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን የተወረሱ ሕጎችን ሽሯል። ይህ ታሪካዊ ውሳኔ የተገኘው የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቹ ጄሰን ጆንስ ለ11 ዓመታት ባደረጉት የሕግ ትግል ነው። ፍርድ ቤቱ እነዚህ ሕጎች የግል ሕይወትን የማክበር መብትን የሚጥሱ በመሆናቸው ተቀባይነት እንደሌላቸው በመግለጽ፣ ለአካባቢው የኤልጂቢቲኪው ማህበረሰብ የእኩልነት ተስፋን ፈንጥቋል።
oromo: Mana maree seeraa Landanitti argamu kan 'Judicial Committee of the Privy Council' jedhamu, seera yeroo kolonii irraa kaasee biyya Tiriniidaad fi Tobeegoo keessatti wal qunnamtii saala wal fakkaataa raawwachuu yakka taasisu haqeera. Murtii seena qabeessa kana kan argame qabsaawaa mirga namoomaa Jeeson Joonsi waggoota 11f sirna seeraa keessatti falmii geggeessaa turee booda. Manni murtichaa seeronni kun mirga icitii dhuunfaa namaa kan sarban ta'uu ibsuun, murtoon kun hawaasa LGBTQ+ naannichaa biratti tarkaanfii gara walqixxummaatti geessuudha.

title: Myanmar summons German envoy over controversial video
english: Myanmar's government has summoned the German embassy's mission head, Mathias Licharz, following a video he posted calling for the release of political prisoners like Aung San Suu Kyi. Officials accused the diplomat of inciting internal unrest by challenging the current administration. In the video, Licharz also identified the ousted leader Win Myint as the country’s legitimate president and stated he is still being held against his will.
amharic: የማያንማር መንግስት የጀርመን ኤምባሲ ተልዕኮ ሃላፊ የሆኑትን ማቲያስ ሊቻርዝን፣ የፖለቲካ እስረኞችን እንዲለቁ በቪዲዮ ጥሪ በማድረጋቸው ወደ ውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ጠርቷቸዋል። ባለስልጣናቱ ዲፕሎማቱ አሁን ያለውን አስተዳደር በመቃወም በአገር ውስጥ ሁከት እንዲቀሰቀስ አድርገዋል ሲሉ ከሰሷቸዋል። በቪዲዮው ላይ ሊቻርዝ የተባረሩትን መሪ ዊን ሚንት ህጋዊ ፕሬዝዳንት እንደሆኑ በመግለጽ አሁንም በግድ እንደታሰሩ ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Myanmar ajaja ergamaa embaasii Jarman, Maatiyaas Liichaarz, viidiyoo isaan hidhamtoota siyaasaa akka Aung Saan Suu Kii akka hiikaman gaafatanii gadhiisaniin walqabatee gara ministeera haajaa alaa waameera. Aangootonni mootummaa, diippiloomaatichi bulchiinsa amma jiru mormuudhaan biyyattii keessatti jeequmsa kakaasaniiru jechuun himataniiru. Viidiyoo sana keessatti, Liichaarz pirezidaantii aangoo irraa bu'an Wiin Miintiin pirezidaantii seera qabeessa biyyattii ta'uu fi hanga ammaa fedhii isaanii malee hidhamanii jiraachuu ibsaniiru.

title: Photos: Crowds greet Pope Leo in Argentina after 40-year wait
english: Pope Leo XIV has concluded a significant three-day visit to Argentina, marking the country's first papal trip in four decades. During massive outdoor masses in Buenos Aires and Cordoba, the Pope encouraged citizens to embody the values of local saints to foster a more compassionate society. Additionally, he used his platform to advocate for social inclusivity and urged the government to protect the rights of the poor and the working class.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ ዐሥራ አራተኛ በአርጀንቲና ያደረጉትን የሦስት ቀናት ጉብኝት አጠናቀዋል። ይህም አገሪቱ ለአርባ ዓመታት ካላየችው ጉብኝት በኋላ የተከናወነ ታሪካዊ ክንውን ነው። ጳጳሱ በቡዌኖስ አይረስ እና በኮርዶባ ባካሄዷቸው የጅምላ ጸሎቶች፣ ህዝቡ የሀገሪቱን ቅዱሳን ምሳሌ በመከተል ፍቅር እና መተሳሰብ የሰፈነበትን ማህበረሰብ እንዲገነቡ አሳስበዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ መንግስት የድሆችን እና የሰራተኞችን መብት እንዲያስከብር ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Paphaasii Leo XIV yeroo waggaa afurtama keessatti si'a jalqabaatiif Arjantiinaatti daawwannaa guyyaa sadii taasisuu isaanii xumiraniiru. Magaalota gurguddoo biyyattii keessatti misa qulqulluu qopheessuun, namoonni biyyattii fakkeenya qulqulloota isaanii hordofuun hawaasa wal-jaalatuu fi wal-qunnuu ta'e akka ijaaran dhaamaniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan hawaasa harka qalleeyyii fi hojjettootaa akka deggeruu fi mirga isaanii akka eegu gorsa kenneera.

title: US petrol prices are down, but elevated inflation continues
english: Although petrol prices in the United States have dropped to a four-month low following reduced tensions with Iran, overall inflation still rose by 0.4 percent in October. Higher costs for essential items like housing and food continue to impact consumer budgets more than experts had initially predicted. This persistent inflation remains a primary concern for the American public and follows recent political shifts in the US government.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን ከአሜሪካ-ኢራን ውጥረት መቀነስ ጋር ተያይዞ በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ባለፉት አራት ወራት ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ላይ ቢደርስም፣ አጠቃላይ የዋጋ ግሽበት በኦክቶበር ወር በ0.4 በመቶ ጨምሯል። እንደ መኖሪያ ቤት እና ምግብ ያሉ መሰረታዊ ነገሮች ዋጋ መጨመር በሸማቾች ላይ ከሚጠበቀው በላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እያሳደረ ይገኛል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው የዋጋ ግሽበት በአሜሪካውያን ዘንድ ትልቅ ስጋት ሆኖ የቀጠለ ሲሆን በቅርቡ በተደረጉ ምርጫዎች ላይም ተፅዕኖ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gatiin boba'aa Ameerikaa keessatti walitti bu'iinsa Iraan wajjin jiru hir'achuu isaatiin gadi bu'us, gatiin meeshaalee biroo waliigalaa ji'a Onkololeessa keessa dhibbeentaa 0.4 dabaleera. Gatiin mana jireenyaa fi nyaataa dabaluun isaa baasii ummataa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa fideera. Gatiin meeshaalee kanneenii dabaluun isaa rakkoo dinagdee guddaa ta'ee itti fufeera, kunis dhiibbaa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti mul'achaa jiru irratti qooda qaba.

title: Iran backs nuclear treaty even as hardliners raise prospect of bomb
english: Despite recent military strikes on its nuclear sites by the US and Israel, Iran officially claims it remains committed to the nuclear non-proliferation treaty. However, the government is facing internal pressure from hardliners who advocate for developing nuclear weapons in response to the ongoing conflict. While Iran continues to limit cooperation with international inspectors, it recently permitted limited monitoring at its Bushehr power plant.
amharic: በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል የኑክሌር ተቋማቱ ላይ ጥቃት ቢደርስበትም፣ ኢራን አሁንም የኑክሌር መስፋፋትን መከላከል በሚመለከት ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነት እንደምትገዛ አስታውቃለች። ይሁን እንጂ፣ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያሉ ጠንካራ አቋም ያላቸው አካላት፣ በግጭቱ ምክንያት የኑክሌር ቦምብ የመስራት አቅጣጫ እንዲከተሉ መንግስትን እየገፋፉት ነው። ኢራን ከአለም አቀፍ የኑክሌር ተቆጣጣሪዎች ጋር ያላትን ትብብር ብትገድብም፣ በቡሼር የኤሌክትሪክ ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ላይ ውስን ክትትል እንዲደረግ ፈቅዳለች።
oromo: Haa ta'u malee, yeroo dhihoo as dhaabbilee niwukilaraa ishee irratti haleellaan US fi Israa'el erga geggeeffamee booda, Iraan waliigaltee niwukilaraa kabajuuf waadaa seente jirti. Ta'us, mootummaan gara keessaa jabeessitoota niwukilaraa qabaachuu barbaadan irraa dhiibbaan cimaan irra ga'aa jira. Iraan hordoffii dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa irratti daangaa kaa'uu itti fiteellee, buufata humna elektirikii Bushehr irratti hordoffii xiqqoo akka geggeeffamu hayyamteetti.

title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in massive stock market debut
english: Anthropic, the developer of the Claude AI chatbot, is preparing for a major public stock market debut next week with a target valuation of $1.4 trillion. The company aims to raise up to $64.4 billion by offering 825 million shares to investors. While the company has seen rapid revenue growth, it faces scrutiny regarding its massive infrastructure spending and the overall sustainability of AI industry investments.
amharic: የClaude AI ቴክኖሎጂን የፈጠረው አንትሮፖፒክ ኩባንያ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት 1.4 ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በሚገመት ዋጋ የአክሲዮን ገበያውን ለመቀላቀል እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ኩባንያው 825 ሚሊዮን አክሲዮኖችን በመሸጥ እስከ 64.4 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለማሰባሰብ አቅዷል። ምንም እንኳን የኩባንያው ገቢ በፍጥነት እያደገ ቢመጣም፣ ከፍተኛ የመሰረተ ልማት ወጪ እና በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ዘርፍ ላይ ያለው የኢንቨስትመንት ቀጣይነት ጥያቄ ውስጥ ገብቷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teeknoolojii Claude AI uume Anthropic jedhamu, torban dhufu gabaa aksiyoonaa seenuuf kan karoorfate yoo ta'u, gatiin dhaabbatichaa tiriliyoona 1.4 kan tilmaamamuudha. Dhaabbatichi aksiyoonota miliyoona 825 gurguruudhaan qarshii biliyoona 64.4 sassaabuuf halkeeffateera. Galii dhaabbatichaa saffisaan guddachaa kan jiru ta'us, baasiin guddannaa teeknoolojii isaa fi guddini gabaa artiifishal intelejenstii irratti qabu shakkii uumuun isaa ibsameera.

title: GCC to establish joint forward-command centre in Kuwait
english: The Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) is establishing a new joint military command centre in Kuwait to strengthen regional integration amid growing uncertainty regarding the United States' security role. This initiative aims to address long-standing gaps in the council's collective defense capabilities, which have struggled to respond effectively to past attacks on member nations. However, critics question the facility's viability given that previous security infrastructure in Kuwait has proven vulnerable to missile and drone strikes.
amharic: የባህረ ሰላጤው አገራት ትብብር ምክር ቤት (GCC) በአካባቢው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ላይ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ሚና አጠያያቂ እየሆነ በመምጣቱ፣ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ዕዝ ማዕከል በኩዌት ሊመሰርት ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አገራቱ ቀደም ሲል ለደረሱባቸው ጥቃቶች ተገቢውን ምላሽ ለመስጠት ሲቸገሩ የነበረውን ክፍተት ለመሙላት የታለመ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ ቀደም ሲል በኩዌት የነበሩ ወታደራዊ መሠረቶች ለድሮን እና ለሚሳይል ጥቃት ተጋላጭ መሆናቸው፣ አዲሱ ማዕከል ውጤታማ ሊሆን ስለመቻሉ ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gumii Mootummoota Gaggeessaa Ghandi (GCC) kutaa biyyaa sanaa keessatti nageenya ilaalchisee gahee Ameerikaan qabdu irratti shakkii dabalaa dhufe hordofee, giddugala ajaja waraanaa gamtaa Kuweytitti hundessuuf murteesseera. Tarkaanfiin kun hanqina ittisa gamtaa kan durii ture sirreessuuf kan gargaaru ta'us, buufatni waraanaa duraan Kuweyt keessa turan haleellaa miisaayilii fi dooniif saaxilamuu isaanii yaadachuun bu'aan isaa kan shakkisiisu ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Oil tanker catches fire after hitting naval mine in Hormuz, Iran says
english: Iranian authorities reported that three oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday. The incidents were confirmed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. No details regarding casualties or the extent of the damage have been provided yet.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ጥበቃ ኃይል እንደገለጸው፣ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ውስጥ ሶስት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች በባህር ፈንጂ በመመታታቸው እሳት ተነስቶባቸዋል። ማክሰኞ ዕለት የተከሰተው ይህ አደጋ በመርከቦቹ ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ስለ ጉዳዩ ዝርዝር ሁኔታ ወይም ስለ ሰዎች ህይወት መትረፍ እስካሁን የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Humni eegumsa koraa kan Iraan akka ibsetti, markaawwan boba'aa sadii dhiphoo Hormuz keessatti miineewwan galaanaatti bu'uudhaan gubachuu isaanii beekameera. Mudannoon kun guyyaa Kibxataatti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, miidhaa gahuus ta'e haala namootaa irratti hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon bal'aan hin kennamne.

title: Joint Tory-Labour motion that 'Zionism is not racism' goes to vote at Westminster council
english: Conservative and Labour councillors in Westminster are presenting a joint motion to formally declare that Zionism is not a form of racism. This initiative serves as a direct response to a recent Green Party vote that had labeled Zionism as racist. The upcoming council vote aims to establish a definition of Zionism as the Jewish people's right to self-determination in their ancestral land.
amharic: የዌስትሚኒስተር የኮንሰርቫቲቭ እና የሌበር ፓርቲ ምክር ቤት አባላት፣ 'ጽዮናዊነት ዘረኝነት አይደለም' የሚል የጋራ የውሳኔ ሃሳብ ለማቅረብ እየተዘጋጁ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ቀደም ሲል አረንጓዴው ፓርቲ ጽዮናዊነትን ዘረኝነት ነው በሚል ካሳለፈው ውሳኔ ጋር በተያያዘ ነው። በጉዳዩ ላይ ረቡዕ ዕለት በሚደረገው ድምጽ አሰጣጥ፣ ጽዮናዊነት የአይሁድ ህዝቦች በታሪካዊ የትውልድ አገራቸው ራሳቸውን በራሳቸው የማስተዳደር መብት እንዳላቸው የሚገልጽ ፍቺ እንዲሰጠው ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Miseensonni mana maree magaalaa Westminster kan paartii Konsarvatiivii fi Leebarii, 'Siyoonaayizimiin sanyii jibbaa miti' jedhu tokkummaan dhiheessuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, kanaan dura paartiin 'Green Party' Siyoonaayizimiin sanyii jibbaati jechuun isaatiin walqabatee dha. Guyyaa Roobii koreen kun sagalee isaa kan kennu yoo ta'u, Siyoonaayizimiin mirga saba Yihuudotaa kan biyyattiin isaan beekamtudha.

title: Israel's parliament sworn in as Eisenkot tries to forge a government
english: Israel's parliament has officially been sworn in following an inconclusive election that left no clear majority for either Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu or his challengers. Former general Gadi Eisenkot has been tasked with forming a government, but he currently lacks the necessary support to secure a coalition. President Isaac Herzog has urged lawmakers to compromise and work together to prevent the country from heading into yet another round of elections.
amharic: በእስራኤል የተካሄደው ምርጫ አሸናፊ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት ፓርላማው ያለ አዲስ መንግስት በይፋ ተመርቋል። የቀድሞው ጄኔራል ጋዲ አይዘንኮት መንግስት ለመመስረት ጥረት እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን በቂ የፓርላማ ድጋፍ ማግኘት አልቻሉም። የሀገሪቱ ፕሬዝዳንት ኢሳቅ ሄርዞግ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች ድርድር በማድረግ ሌላ ምርጫ እንዳይኖር እንዲሰሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Filannoo biyyattii irratti mo'ataan ifatti waan hin argamneef, mana mareen Israa'el mootummaa haaraa malee eebbifameera. Ajajaan duraanii Gaadii Ayizankot mootummaa ijaaruuf carraaqqii gochaa jiranis, hamma yoonaatti deggarsa gahaa argachuu hin dandeenye. Pirezidaantiin biyyattii Isaak Herzoog, paartiileen siyaasaa walii galuun filannoo biraa akka hin dhufneef akka waliin hojjetan dhaamaniiru.

title: G7 agrees on need to avoid 'security void' in Lebanon after UN force mandate ends
english: G7 foreign ministers have expressed concerns regarding a potential security vacuum in Lebanon once the current UN peacekeeping mandate concludes at the end of the year. They reached a consensus on the urgent need to establish a new security framework to maintain stability in the region. However, no specific decisions have been made yet on what will replace the existing force, which has been active for decades.
amharic: የሰባቱ ሀገራት (G7) የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ስልጣን በዓመቱ መጨረሻ ሲያበቃ በሊባኖስ የፀጥታ ክፍተት ሊፈጠር እንደሚችል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። በክልሉ መረጋጋትን ለማስጠበቅ አዲስ የፀጥታ ማዕቀፍ በፍጥነት መዘርጋት እንዳለባቸው ተስማምተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ከ1978 ጀምሮ ሲያገለግል የነበረውን የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል ማን እንደሚተካው እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ውሳኔ ላይ አልደረሱም።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota G7, ergamni waraana nageenya kabachiiftuu UN dhuma waggaa irratti yoo xumurame, biyya Liibaanoos keessatti qaawwi nageenyaa uumamuu akka danda'u yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru. Naannichatti tasgabbii eeguuf, hundaawa nageenyaa haaraa saffisaan diriirsuun akka barbaachisu walii galaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, waraana waggoota hedduuf tajaajilaa ture kana kan bakka bu'u maal akka ta'e irratti hanga ammaatti murtoon tokko illee hin irra ga'amne.

title: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo
english: A police officer was killed and another seriously wounded in Oviedo, Spain, when an explosive device hidden in a backpack detonated while they were inspecting it. The incident followed a reported neighborhood dispute that left a woman suffering from gunshot wounds. Authorities are currently conducting a major manhunt for the suspect who fled the area.
amharic: በስፔን ኦቪዬዶ ከተማ የፖሊስ አባላት አጠራጣሪ ቦርሳን ለመመርመር በሞከሩበት ወቅት በተፈጠረ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ አንድ የፖሊስ አባል ሲሞት ሌላኛው ደግሞ ከባድ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ይህ ክስተት የተፈጠረው በጎረቤቶች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት የተኩስ ድርጊት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ነው። ተጠርጣሪው ከቦታው አምልጦ አሁንም በፖሊስ እየተፈለገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Magaalaal Oviyeedoo kan Ispeen keessatti, poolisonni boorsaa shakkamaa tokko qorachaa jiran utuu jiranii baor-qophiin tokko dhohee poolisii tokko ajjeese, kan biraa ammoo cimaa miidheera. Dhiheenya kana walitti bu'iinsa ollaa gidduutti uumameen dubartii tokko irratti dhukaasni erga raawwatamee booda poolisoonni iddoo sanatti argaman turan. Shakkamichi iddoo sana irraa kan badde yoo ta'u, poolisoonni amma iyyuu isa sakatta'aa jiru.

title: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore
english: A long-term global cruise ship called The Odyssey has been seized by authorities in Singapore following its operator's financial collapse. The company, Villa Vie Residences, suddenly halted operations last month, leaving approximately 200 passengers stranded in Cambodia. The vessel, which was intended to sail for three years visiting 150 countries, remains in Singapore under a court order while creditors handle the crew's wellbeing.
amharic: ዘ ኦዲሲ የተሰኘው ዓለም አቀፍ የሽርሽር መርከብ፣ ኦፕሬተሩ በገጠመው የገንዘብ ችግር ምክንያት በሲንጋፖር ባለስልጣናት ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ቪላ ቪ ረዚደንሲስ የተባለው ኩባንያ ካለፈው ወር ጀምሮ ስራውን በማቆሙ በካምቦዲያ የነበሩ ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ ተሳፋሪዎች ተጉላተዋል። ለሶስት አመታት 150 ሀገራትን ለመጎብኘት ታቅዶ የነበረው ይህ መርከብ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በፍርድ ቤት ትእዛዝ በሲንጋፖር ወደብ ታግቶ የሚገኝ ሲሆን የሰራተኞቹ ሁኔታ በአበዳሪዎች እየተጣራ ነው።
oromo: Markabni 'The Odyssey' jedhamu kan ganna sadii guutuu addunyaa naanna'uuf karoorfate, rakkoo faayinaansii dhaabbata isaa irraa kan ka'e Singappooritti qabamee jira. Dhaabbatichi 'Villa Vie Residences' jedhamu ji'a darbe hojii isaa dhaabuun isaa, imaltoota 200 ta'an Kaamboodiyaatti rakkoo keessa akka galan taasiseera. Markabichi amma abbaa taayitaa Singappoorin ajaja mana murtiitiin kan qabame yoo ta'u, gaaffiin nageenyaa fi walitti dhufeenyi hojjettootaa immoo abbootii qabeenyaa biraan qulqullaa'aa jira.

title: Humanoid robot takes on Antarctic ultra-marathon… and fails
english: A humanoid robot attempted to complete an ultra-marathon in the harsh environment of Antarctica. However, the machine was unsuccessful in finishing the demanding race. The attempt highlighted the significant challenges technology faces when operating in extreme polar conditions.
amharic: አንድ ሰውን መሰል ሮቦት በአንታርክቲካ አስቸጋሪ የአየር ንብረት ውስጥ የአልትራ ማራቶን ውድድር ለመጨረስ ሙከራ አድርጎ ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ሮቦቱ ውድድሩን ማጠናቀቅ አልቻለም። ይህ ሙከራ ቴክኖሎጂ በከባድ የበረዶ አካባቢዎች ሲሰራ የሚያጋጥሙትን ከፍተኛ ተግዳሮቶች የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Roobotiin bifa namaa qabu tokko naannoo Antarktiikaa keessatti fiigicha dheeraa (ultra-marathon) xumuruuf yaalii godhee ture. Haa ta'u malee, roobotiin sun fiigicha sana xumuruu hin dandeenye. Yaalii kun teeknooloojiin haala qilleensa cimaa fi qabbanaa'aa ta'e keessatti hojjechuun hangam ulfaataa akka ta'e kan mul'isu dha.

title: UK author M John Harrison’s End of Everything wins Booker Prize
english: British author M. John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize for his dystopian novel, The End of Everything. At 81 years old, he is the oldest person to ever receive this prestigious award for his story about life in Britain following a mysterious global catastrophe. The judges praised the work as a unique blend of genres that captures the uncertainty of modern times.
amharic: ብሪታንያዊው ደራሲ ኤም ጆን ሃሪሰን በ2026 የቡከር ሽልማትን በ‹‹ዘ ኤንድ ኦፍ ኤቭሪቲንግ›› በተሰኘው የዲስቶፒያን ልብወለድ መጽሐፋቸው አሸንፈዋል። በ81 ዓመታቸው የዚህን ክብር ያገኙ ትልቁ ሰው በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርተዋል፤ መጽሐፉም እንግዳ በሆነ ዓለም አቀፋዊ አደጋ የተጎዳች ብሪታንያን ያሳያል። ዳኞቹ መጽሐፉን ወቅታዊ አለመረጋጋትን በልዩ የጽሁፍ ዘይቤ የሚገልጽ ድንቅ ስራ ሲሉ አወድሰውታል።
oromo: barreessaan biyya Ingiliz M. John Harrison bu'uura barreeffama isaanii 'The End of Everything' jedhamuun badhaasa Booker Prize bara 2026 injifataniiru. Umriin isaanii waggaa 81 ta'uun, nama badhaasa kana fudhate keessaa isa hangafa ta'aniiru. Labseewwan isaanis badhaasichi balaa addunyaa irra ga'e booda biyya Ingiliz keessatti jireenya haala kamin akka jiru kan ibsuufi haala yeroo ammaa kanaa kan calaqqisu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Pakistan TV anchor allegedly shot dead at home by her husband
english: Pakistani television presenter Rabiya Ahsan was killed after being shot in her home. Her husband is currently the primary suspect in the incident. Police are now conducting an investigation to verify the husband's claim that the shooting was unintentional.
amharic: የፓኪስታኗ የቴሌቪዥን ጋዜጠኛ ረቢያ አህሳን በቤቷ ውስጥ በጥይት ተመትታ መሞቷ ተገልጿል። ባለቤቷ ለዚህ ግድያ ዋና ተጠርጣሪ ሆኗል። ባለቤቷ ድርጊቱ በአጋጣሚ የተፈጠረ ነው በማለት የሰጠውን ቃል ለማጣራት ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun televizhinii Paakistaan Rabiiyaa Ahsaan mana ishee keessatti rasaasaan rukutamtee lubbuun ishee darbeera. Abbaan manaa ishee ajjeechaa kana keessatti shakkamaa guddaa ta'eera. Ajjeechaan kun tasa kan uumame ta'uu isaatiin ibsa abbaan manaa ishee kenne mirkaneeffachuuf qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira.

title: What is Hasina’s game plan as she seeks a passport to return to Bangladesh?
english: Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is seeking a new passport to return home from exile in India, despite being sentenced to death for her role in the violent crackdown on 2024 protests. The current Bangladeshi government has denied her request and warned that she will face execution if she returns. Analysts suggest that Hasina may be using this public bid to maintain political relevance rather than genuinely intending to face legal consequences.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና በ2024 በተነሳው ተቃውሞ ወቅት በተፈጸመው ግድያ የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባቸው በህንድ በስደት ላይ ቢሆኑም ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ ፓስፖርት እየጠየቁ ነው። የአሁኑ የባንግላዲሽ መንግስት ጥያቄያቸውን ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን ወደ ሀገር ከተመለሱ የሞት ፍርዱ እንደሚፈጸምባቸው አስጠንቅቋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ሀሲና ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት በፖለቲካው ዓለም ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለማስቀጠል እንጂ በእርግጥ ለህግ ለመቅረብ ላይሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa biyyattii duraanii Sheikh Hasina, bara 2024 hiriira mormii irratti ajjeechaa raawwatameef adabbii du'aa itti murteeffamee osoo jiruu, biyyattiitti deebi'uuf paaspoortii gaafachaa jiru. Mootummaan ammaa gaaffii isaanii kana kan dide yoo ta'u, biyyattiitti deebi'an adabbiin du'aa irratti raawwatama jedheera. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, Hasina tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan seeratti dhiyaachuuf utuu hin taane, siyaasa keessatti iddoo qabaachuufi deeggarsa isaanii jajjabeessuuf ta'uu mala.

title: Nvidia spy scandal fuels debate over chip exports to China
english: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing a corporate investigation following reports that he had an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent. This scandal has intensified pressure from US lawmakers to implement stricter controls on the export of advanced microchips to China. While Huang previously lobbied against such restrictions, his current situation has triggered both internal company reviews and an FBI inquiry regarding potential national security risks.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት ነበራቸው በሚል የቀረበውን ክስ ተከትሎ ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ይገኛል። ይህ ክስተት አሜሪካ ለቻይና የምትልካቸውን ዘመናዊ ቺፖች ለመቆጣጠር በህግ አውጪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ግፊት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ቀደም ሲል የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖርት ገደቦችን በመቃወም ይታወቁ የነበሩት ሁአንግ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በኩባንያው እና በኤፍቢአይ (FBI) የሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Nvidia Jensen Huang, dubartii garee basaastota Chaayinaa keessa jirti jedhamtu waliin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuu isaatiin qorannoon irratti banameera. Rakkoon kun, biyyi Ameerikaa teeknoolojii 'chip' (chip) gara Chaayinaatti ergitu irratti dhiibbaa cimaa gochuuf akka isheen tarkaanfii fudhattu godheera. Kanaan dura daldala chip irratti uggurri akka hin jiraanne falmaa turus, amma qorannoon dhaabbatichaa fi kan FBI (FBI) irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru nageenya biyyaalessaa waliin walqabatee yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that the FBI is investigating the CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, due to his romantic relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. While Trump noted that Huang denied any knowledge of the woman's background, the controversy caused Nvidia's stock value to drop significantly. The company is currently conducting its own independent inquiry and insists that its internal secrets and national security interests remain safe.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር በተጠረጠረች ሴት ላይ ባላቸው ግንኙነት ምክንያት የኤፍቢአይ ምርመራ እየተካሄደባቸው መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ትራምፕ እንደገለጹት ሁአንግ ስለ ሴትየዋ የስለላ ስራ ምንም እንደማያውቁ ተናግረዋል፣ ነገር ግን ይህ ውዝግብ የኩባንያውን የአክሲዮን ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። ኩባንያው ጉዳዩን በራሱ በኩል እያጣራ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ምንም አይነት የደህንነት ስጋት እንዳልተፈጠረ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traamp qajeelchi FBI qindeessaa olaanaa dhaabbata Nvidia, Jeensen Huwaang, dubartii basaastuu Chaayinaa taate jedhamtee shakkamtuu tokkoo wajjin hariiroo qabaachuu isaa qorachaa jiraachuu mirkaneessaniiru. Traamp akka jedhanitti, Huwaang waa'ee basaastummaa dubartittii akka hin beekne himanii jiru, ta'us oduun kun gatii aksiyoona dhaabbata Nvidia akka gad-bu'u godhee jira. Dhaabbatichi mataa isaa qorannoo geggeessaa jiruufi hanga ammaa icciitiiwwan dhaabbatichaa ykn nageenyi biyyaa akka hin miidhamne ibsee jira.

title: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
english: Representatives from Ukraine, Russia, and the United States are meeting in Abu Dhabi to discuss potential postwar security arrangements. While both countries remain publicly divided over the control of eastern territories, U.S. officials report that both sides have shown some private flexibility. The talks focus on establishing a new security framework, as both nations recognize that territorial disputes cannot be resolved without a broader agreement on long-term safety.
amharic: የዩክሬን፣ የሩሲያ እና የአሜሪካ ተወካዮች ከጦርነት በኋላ ሊኖር ስለሚችለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ለመወያየት በአቡ ዳቢ ተገናኝተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱ ሀገራት በምስራቅ ግዛቶች ቁጥጥር ጉዳይ በይፋ ቢለያዩም፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ሁለቱም ወገኖች በግል ደረጃ የተወሰነ የመደራደር ፍላጎት ማሳየታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ውይይቶቹ የሚያተኩሩት አዲስ የጸጥታ ማዕቀፍ በመፍጠር ላይ ሲሆን፣ የክልል አለመግባባቶች ያለ ዘላቂ የጸጥታ ስምምነት ሊፈቱ እንደማይችሉ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ተገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Bakka bu'oonni Yukreen, Raashiyaa fi Ameerikaa marii nageenyaa booda ta'uu malu irratti mari'achuuf Abuu Daabii walga'anii jiru. Biyyoonni lamaanuu naannoolee bahaa irratti dhiibbaa mataa isaanii kan qaban ta'us, qondaaltotni Ameerikaa akka jedhanitti gama lamaanuun marii dhuunfaa irratti wal-danda'uun mul'achaa jira. Mariin kun sirna nageenyaa haaraa diriirsuu irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, rakkoolee daangaa hiikuun malee nageenya gara fuulduraa mirkaneessuun akka hin danda'amne hubatameera.

title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
english: A woman who was sexually abused by Jeffrey Epstein claims that her former modeling agency president knowingly sent her to his home for photoshoots, placing her in significant danger. While the agency head, Jeff Fuller, previously denied knowledge of these visits, records indicate the agency had extensive financial and professional ties to Epstein. The survivor is now demanding accountability, arguing that the people who were supposed to protect her failed to do so.
amharic: ጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን የተባለ ግለሰብ በፆታዊ ጥቃት የደረሰባት አንዲት ሞዴል፣ የቀድሞዋ የሞዴሊንግ ኤጀንሲዋ ኃላፊ ሆን ብለው ወደ ኤፕስታይን ቤት እንደላኳት ትናገራለች። የኤጀንሲው ኃላፊ የነበሩት ጄፍ ፉለር ጉዳዩን እንደማያውቁ ቢክዱም፣ ኤጀንሲው ከኤፕስታይን ጋር የቅርብ የገንዘብ እና የሥራ ግንኙነት እንደነበረው ማስረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። ጥቃት የተፈጸመባት ወይዘሮዋ፣ ሊጠብቋት የነበሩ አካላት ኃላፊነታቸውን በመወጣት ረገድ በመውደቃቸው ተጠያቂ መሆን አለባቸው ብላለች።
oromo: Dubartiin tokko Jefrii Episteeniin gudeedamee fi miidhaa irra ga'e, hoogganaan dhaabbata moodeelii ishee kanaan duraa akka beekutti gara mana Episteen erguun ishee balaaf ishee saaxileera jechuun himatte. Haa ta'u malee, hogganaan dhaabbata sanaa Jef Fuuler waa'ee daawwannaa sanaa akka hin beekne yoo dubbatanis, dhaabbatichi Episteen wajjin walitti dhufeenya maallaqaa fi hojii cimaa akka qaban ragaan ni mirkaneessa. Miidhaan irra ga'e kun, qaamoleen ishee eeguu qaban dirqama isaanii bahachuu waan dadhabaniif seera duratti gaafatamu qabu jettee dubbatti.

title: Russia, Ukraine and US to meet as Zelenskyy claims battlefield successes
english: Representatives from Russia and Ukraine are scheduled to meet in Abu Dhabi for US-mediated peace talks. President Zelenskyy claims that recent military victories and heavy Russian losses have improved Ukraine's position, while President Trump suggests that both nations are increasingly motivated to find a resolution. The upcoming meeting aims to advance diplomatic efforts to end the prolonged conflict.
amharic: የሩሲያ እና የዩክሬን ተወካዮች በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በአቡ ዳቢ ለሰላም ንግግር ለመገናኘት ተዘጋጅተዋል። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ በቅርቡ በጦር ሜዳ ያገኟቸው ድሎች እና የሩሲያ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የዩክሬንን ድርድር አቅም እንዳጠናከረው ገልጸዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው ሁለቱም ወገኖች ግጭቱን ለማቆም ፍላጎት እያሳዩ እንደሆነ የጠቆሙ ሲሆን፣ መጪው ስብሰባ ጦርነቱን ለመፍታት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Bakka bu'oonni Raashiyaa fi Yuukreeniin marii nagaa Ameerikaan gidduu seenteen Abu Daabii keessatti wal arguuf qophaa'aniiru. Prezidaantiin Yuukreen Zeelenskiin injifannoo garraattiirra argamee fi miidhaan Raashiyaarra ga'e Yuukreen marii keessatti qabsoo cimaa akka qabaattu taasiseera jedhan. Prezidaantiin Traamp gamasaaniin, biyyoonni lamaanuu waraana kana xumuruuf fedhii qabaachuu isaanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, mariin kun furmaata argamsiisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Cameroon sets date for twice-delayed legislative and local elections
english: Cameroon’s 93-year-old President Paul Biya has scheduled long-overdue legislative and municipal elections for February 7. These polls, which have been postponed twice before, occur amid a climate of political tension and government crackdowns on the opposition. Public concern regarding the president's health and future leadership succession remains high as the country continues to wait for a promised government reshuffle.
amharic: የካሜሩኑ የ93 ዓመት አዛውንት ፕሬዝዳንት ፖል ቢያ፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲዘገዩ የቆዩትን የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት እና የአካባቢ ምርጫዎች ለየካቲት 7 ቀን ቀጠሮ አስይዘዋል። በሁለት ጊዜያት ቀድመው ተራዝመው የነበሩት እነዚህ ምርጫዎች፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአገሪቱ በሚታየው ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት እና በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ የሚወሰደው ጥብቅ እርምጃ በተሞላበት ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይከናወናሉ። የአገሪቱ ሕዝብ በፕሬዝዳንቱ ጤንነት እና በሥልጣን ሽግግር ጉዳይ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ባለበት ወቅት፣ መንግሥት ቃል ገብቶት የነበረው የአስተዳደር ለውጥ እስካሁን አልተፈጸመም።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kaameeruun umurii isaanii waggaa 93 ta'e Pool Biyaa, filannoon seera baastuu fi kan naannoo irra deddeebiin turte sun Guraandhala 7 akka gaggeeffamu labsaniiru. Filannoon kun yeroo lama dura kan dhiibame yoo ta'u, amma kan gaggeeffamu mormitoota irratti dhiibbaa fi gidiraa cimaa mootummaan geessisaa jiru keessatti. Dhimmi fayyaa pireezidaantichaa fi guddina biyyattii irratti gaaffiin guddaan waan jiruuf, jijjiirraa mootummaa yeroo dheeraaf eeggamaa turan irratti xiyyeeffannoon guddaan jira.

title: Israel’s Shin Bet finds no evidence of foreign election interference
english: Israel's internal security agency, the Shin Bet, has concluded that there was no involvement from foreign entities in the recent national elections. This investigation was launched following public debate and concerns regarding potential outside influence, particularly after Palestinian-Israeli political groups saw significant progress. The agency's findings have effectively dismissed claims that international actors attempted to manipulate the electoral process.
amharic: የእስራኤል የውስጥ ደህንነት ኤጀንሲ (ሺን ቤት) በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ሀገራዊ ምርጫ የውጭ ሀገራት ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደሌለ አረጋግጧል። ይህ ምርመራ የተካሄደው በተለይም የፍልስጤም-እስራኤል የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች ከፍተኛ ውጤት ካስመዘገቡ በኋላ በተነሱ ስጋቶች እና ውዝግቦች ሳቢያ ነበር። የደህንነት መስሪያ ቤቱ በምርጫ ሂደቱ ላይ የውጭ አካላት ተጽዕኖ ፈጥረዋል የሚባለውን ውንጀላ ውድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hojmaanni nageenyaa keessaa Israa'el, Shin Bet, filannoo biyyoolessaa darbe keessatti biyyoonni alaa harka akka hin qabanne mirkaneesseera. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame, keessattuu gareewwan siyaasaa Falasxiin-Israa'el bu'aa guddaa argachuusaanii hordofee shakkii fi falmii uumamee ture. Ejansichi, qaamoleen alaa adeemsa filannichaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaniiru jedhamee himatame hunda dhugaa akka hin qabne ibseera.

title: Poll finds Americans less likely to back pro-war candidates by 3-1 margin
english: A recent YouGov poll shows that Americans are significantly less likely to support political candidates who favor the ongoing war against Iran. Voters are prioritizing domestic economic concerns, such as rising prices, over the military objectives pursued by the Trump administration. Furthermore, a majority of citizens believe that Congress, rather than the president, should hold the final authority regarding the duration of the conflict.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የዩጎቭ (YouGov) የሕዝብ አስተያየት ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው አሜሪካውያን በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት የሚደግፉ እጩዎችን የመምረጥ ፍላጎታቸው በጣም ዝቅተኛ ነው። መራጮች በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከሚካሄዱ ወታደራዊ ግቦች ይልቅ የዋጋ ንረትን የመሳሰሉ የሀገር ውስጥ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮችን ያስቀድማሉ። በተጨማሪም አብዛኛው ህዝብ ጦርነቱ መቼ ማቆም እንዳለበት የመወሰን ስልጣን የፕሬዝዳንቱ ሳይሆን የኮንግረስ መሆን አለበት ብሎ ያምናል።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan YouGov agarsiisutti, namoonni Ameerikaa hogganoota waraana Iraan irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru deggeran filachuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibseera. Namoonni biyyattii waa'ee waraana kanaa irra caalaatti dhimma diinagdee fi daballii gatii gabaa irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru. Akkasumas, namoonni hedduun waraanni kun yoom akka dhaabbatu murteessuun aangoo Kongiresii akka ta'e malee, aangoo pirezidaantii miti jedhanii amanu.

title: France blames Iran for October supermarket cyberattack
english: The French Foreign Minister has formally accused Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps of orchestrating a cyberattack last October. This digital assault targeted refrigeration systems across hundreds of supermarkets throughout France. Authorities identified the military organization as being responsible for the widespread technical disruption.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ባለፈው ጥቅምት ወር በፈረንሳይ የሱፐርማርኬት ማቀዝቀዣዎች ላይ ለተፈጸመው የሳይበር ጥቃት የኢራኑ እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃላፊነቱን እንደሚወስድ በይፋ ከሰሱ። ጥቃቱ በመላ ሀገሪቱ በሚገኙ በመቶዎች በሚቆጠሩ መደብሮች ውስጥ በሚገኙ ማቀዝቀዣዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህንን መጠነ ሰፊ የቴክኖሎጂ ረብሻ የፈጸመው የኢራን ወታደራዊ ክፍል መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Faransaay, ji’a Onkololeessa darbe buufataalee gurgurtaa gurguddaa (supermarket) Faransaay keessatti rakkoo tekinooloojii uumameef humna tiksuu isaanii kan ta’e 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' kan Iiraan akka himatan beekameera. Hojiin badii kun suuqota biyyattii keessatti argaman dhibbaan lakkaawaman keessatti firiijjiiwwan qabbaneessitoota irratti miidhaa geessiseera. Mootummaan Faransaay balaa kana qindeessee kan raawwate qaama waraana Iiraan ta’uu ibseera.

title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
english: The French government has officially accused Iran's Revolutionary Guard of orchestrating a large-scale cyberattack that disabled supermarket cooling systems, resulting in significant food waste. Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot condemned the act as a serious threat to national security and confirmed that France will impose sanctions in response. While Iranian officials have dismissed these claims, French authorities have launched a formal investigation into a specific hacking unit linked to the Iranian military.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ መንግስት የአገሪቱን የሱፐርማርኬት ማቀዝቀዣዎች በመስመር ላይ ጥቃት በማበላሸት ከፍተኛ የምግብ ብክነት እንዲፈጠር ያደረገው የአራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ቡድን ነው ሲል በይፋ ከሰሰ። የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዣን-ኖኤል ባሮት ይህ ድርጊት ለብሄራዊ ደህንነት ከፍተኛ ስጋት መሆኑን ገልፀው ፈረንሳይ በአጥቂዎቹ ላይ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረጉ ቢሆንም የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት ከኢራን ወታደራዊ ክፍል ጋር ግንኙነት አለው በተባለው የሃከሮች ቡድን ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay gareen waraana Iraan 'Revolutionary Guard' jedhamu, sirna qabbaneessituu (firiji) suuqiiwwan gurgurtaa Faransaay irratti qindeessee daa'ima koopputuu gurguddaa akkasumas nyaata hedduu mancaasuusaa himateera. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Faransaay Jean-Noël Barrot, qaqqabbiin kun nageenya biyyaattiif soda guddaa ta'uu ibsuun, Faransaay tarkaanfii sanadaa irratti fudhachuuf akka jirtu beeksisaniiru. Mootummaan Iraan himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta'u, qorannoon Faransaay garuu garee haakeroota Iraan waliin hidhata qabu irratti eegalameera.

title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
english: Nvidia’s stock value dropped significantly after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. While the company maintains that no trade secrets or national security interests were harmed, the board has launched an independent investigation into the matter. Furthermore, US lawmakers have requested that Huang attend a private briefing to discuss his personal ties and the firm's security measures against foreign espionage.
amharic: የኢንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው በማመናቸው የኩባንያው የአክሲዮን ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ኩባንያው ምንም አይነት ሚስጥራዊ መረጃ እንዳልተሰረቀ ቢገልጽም፣ የዳይሬክተሮች ቦርድ በአሁኑ ወቅት ጉዳዩን በገለልተኛ አካል እያጣራ ይገኛል። በተጨማሪም፣ የአሜሪካ የህግ አውጭዎች የኩባንያውን ደህንነትና የሁዋንግን የግል ግንኙነት ለመመርመር ከእሳቸው ጋር በሚስጥር ለመወያየት ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል።
oromo: Hoggansaan dhaabbata Nvidia, Jensen Huang, dubartii garee basaastota Chaayinaa keessaa ishee tokko jedhamtu waliin hariiroo fedhii foonii qabaachuu isaa erga amanee booda, gatiin aksiyoona dhaabbatichaa gadi bu'eera. Dhaabbatichi waa'ee iccitii teeknooloojii ykn nageenya biyyaalessaa irratti miidhaan tokko illee akka hin geenyee ibsuus, boordiin qajeelchaa qorannoo bilisa ta'e jalqabeera. Kana malees, abbootiin seeraa Ameerikaa hariiroo dhuunfaa hogganaa kanaa fi eegumsa teeknooloojii dhaabbatichaa irratti ibsa kennuuf akka dhiyaatu waamicha taasisaniiru.

title: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
english: President Donald Trump has raised doubts about the integrity of the midterm election results despite previously stating he would accept the outcome. Although Democrats won majorities in both houses of Congress following a performance that aligned with pre-election polls, Trump claimed without evidence that the voting process was dishonest. Experts and election officials maintain that the election was conducted smoothly and that the vote-counting process followed standard procedures.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከዚህ ቀደም የምርጫውን ውጤት እንደሚቀበሉ ቢናገሩም፣ አሁን ግን በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ውጤት ታማኝነት ላይ ጥርጣሬያቸውን ገልጸዋል። ዲሞክራቶች በሁለቱም የምክር ቤት ክፍሎች አብላጫ ድምፅ ቢያገኙም፣ ትራምፕ ምንም አይነት ማስረጃ ሳያቀርቡ ምርጫው ታማኝ እንዳልነበር በመግለጽ ውንጀላ ሰንዝረዋል። የምርጫ ባለሙያዎች እና የሀገር ውስጥ ባለስልጣናት ግን ምርጫው በሰላም እና በተለመደው የሂደት አሰራር መሰረት መጠናቀቁን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traamp kanaan dura bu'aa filannichaa akka fudhatan ibsuun isaanii kan yaadatamu ta'us, amma garuu amanamummaa filannoo giddu-galeessaa irratti shakki qaban ibsaniiru. Paartiin Diimokraatotaa mana maree lamaan keessattuu injifannoo argachuu isaanii fi kunis yaada uummataa dursanii qoratamanii turan waliin kan deemu ta'us, Traamp ragaa tokko malee filannichi haqaan akka hin geggeeffamne dubbataniiru. Hayyoonni fi ogeeyyoonni filannoo gama isaaniin, filannichi sirnaan fi karaa nagaa ta'een geggeeffamuu isaa fi hujiin lakkoofsa sagalee sirnaan raawwatamuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
english: A major explosion at the Habas iron and steel plant in Turkey's Izmir province has left 17 workers dead and 12 others injured. The accident occurred during routine maintenance when a crane collapsed, causing equipment to fall into a furnace. Authorities are currently conducting investigations into the incident, and five individuals have already been taken into custody.
amharic: በቱርክ ኢዝሚር ግዛት በሚገኘው የሀባስ ብረት እና ብረት ፋብሪካ በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ 17 ሠራተኞች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 12 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የደረሰው መደበኛ የጥገና ሥራ እየተከናወነ ባለበት ወቅት ክሬን በመውደቁ ምክንያት ቁሳቁሶች ምድጃ ውስጥ በመግባታቸው ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ እስከ አሁን ድረስ አምስት ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Turkiitti, godina Izmiritti, warshaa sibiilaa Habas jedhamu keessatti balaa dhohuu mudateen hojjettoonni 17 du'anii 12 immoo madaa'aniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo suphaa idilee geggeeffamaa turetti maashiniin (crane) kufee meeshaaleen ibidda keessa seenuudhaan dha. Aangeyyoonni balaa kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, namoonni shan ammoo to'annaa jala oolaniiru.

title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
english: Republican Congressman Thomas Massie is forcing a vote to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of illegally conducting military operations in Iran without legislative approval. While the move is unlikely to succeed, Massie argues it is necessary to hold the Secretary accountable and encourages President Trump to appoint a replacement before Democrats take control of Congress. Hegseth has dismissed the threat, stating he is not concerned about the impeachment efforts.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲው የኮንግረስ አባል ቶማስ ማሲ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ኢራን ውስጥ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ወስደዋል በሚል ክስ በስልጣን እንዲነሱ ለማድረግ እየሞከሩ ነው። ይህ ሙከራ ስኬታማ የመሆን እድሉ ዝቅተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ማሲ ሚኒስትሩ ተጠያቂ መሆን አለባቸው በማለት ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ዲሞክራቶች ስልጣን ከመረከባቸው በፊት ተተኪ እንዲሾሙ ይገፋፋሉ። ሚኒስትር ሄግሴት በበኩላቸው ክሱን እንደማይጨነቁበት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Miseensi Kongirasii paartii Rippabilikanii Tomaas Maasii, Ministirri Ittisaa Piit Heegseth hayyama seeraan ala gara biyya Iraan duula waraanaa gaggeessaniiru jechuun, aangoo irraa akka ka'an gochuuf sagalee akka kennamuuf dirqisiisaa jiru. Yaaliin kun milkaa'uun isaa kan hin oolle ta'us, Maasii tarkaanfiin kun Ministirichi itti gaafatama akka fudhatan taasisa fi Pirezidaant Traamp ammoo gareen Demokiraatotaa aangoo fudhachuu isaanii dura bakka bu'aa biraa akka ramadan gorsu jedhu. Heegseth gama isaaniitiin, yaalii kana baay'isee akka hin yaaddofne ibsaniiru.

title: Deadly explosion at Iron and steel plant in Turkiye
english: A major explosion at an iron and steel factory in the Izmir province of Turkey has resulted in the deaths of at least 16 employees. President Recep Tayyip Erdogan confirmed the tragedy, while noting that 13 other workers sustained injuries. Emergency teams are currently conducting search and rescue efforts, as it is believed that additional people may still be buried beneath the wreckage.
amharic: በቱርክ ኢዝሚር ግዛት በሚገኝ የብረት ፋብሪካ ውስጥ በተከሰተ ከባድ ፍንዳታ ቢያንስ 16 ሠራተኞች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶጋን እንደገለጹት፣ ሌሎች 13 ሠራተኞችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በፍርስራሹ ስር ተጠምደው የሚገኙ ሠራተኞች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ በመሰጋቱ የነፍስ አድን ስራው አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Turkiitti naannoo Izmiritti qorqoorroo fi sibiila oomishuun kan beekamu warshaa tokko keessatti dhohiinsa guddaa uumameen hojjettoonni 16 ol ta'an du'aniiru. Pireezidaantiin Turki Recep Tayyip Erdogan akka mirkaneessanitti, namoonni 13 immoo miidhaan irra ga'ee jira. Hojjettoonni biroo diigama warshichaa jalatti hafuu danda'u waan shakkameef, hojiin barbaacha fi lubbuu oolchuu ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10.5 years over sexual assault charges
english: Russell Brand has received a prison sentence of ten and a half years following his conviction for multiple sexual offenses. The court found him guilty of raping one woman and assaulting three others between 2004 and 2009. The presiding judge criticized Brand for exploiting his fame to abuse his victims.
amharic: ረሰል ብራንድ በፈጸማቸው ተከታታይ የጾታ ጥቃት ወንጀሎች የ10 ዓመት ከስድስት ወር እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። በ2004 እና በ2009 መካከል በአንድ ሴት ላይ አስገድዶ መድፈር እና በሌሎች ሶስት ሴቶች ላይ ደግሞ የጾታ ጥቃት መፈጸሙ ተረጋግጧል። ዳኛው ተዋናዩ ዝናውን በመጠቀም ሴቶችን ሲበድል እንደነበር በመግለጽ ድርጊቱን አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Raassel Biraandi yakka saalaa raawwateen waggaa kudhanii fi ji'a ja'aaf hidhutti murameera. Biraandi bara 2004 fi 2009 gidduutti dubartii tokko irratti gudeeddii fi dubartoota biroo sadii irratti yakka saalaa raawwachuun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Manni murtichaa beekamtii isaa fayyadamuun dubartoota miidhuu isaa balaaleffateera.

title: Explosion at Turkish steel plant kills at least 16 people
english: A tragic explosion at the HABAS steel plant in Aliaga, Turkey, has resulted in the deaths of at least 16 people and left 13 others injured. The incident occurred when an overhead crane collapsed into an industrial furnace during maintenance work, prompting President Erdogan to order a formal investigation.
